description: Every subset of omega is ordinal-closed; even and odd sets are disjoint clubs, and their placement at the first two indices gives a diagonal intersection contained in {0,1} that is not club.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.ClubsAndStationarySets.parity_clubs :
  IsClub {n | n % 2 = 0} ∧
    IsClub {n | n % 2 = 1} ∧
      {n | n % 2 = 0} ∩ {n | n % 2 = 1} = ∅ ∧
        (∀ (C : Set ℕ), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.IsOrdinalClosed C) ∧
          ¬IsClub
                (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.diagonalIntersection fun n =>
                  if n = 0 then {m | m % 2 = 0} else if n = 1 then {m | m % 2 = 1} else Set.univ) ∧
            (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.diagonalIntersection fun n =>
                if n = 0 then {m | m % 2 = 0} else if n = 1 then {m | m % 2 = 1} else Set.univ) ⊆
              {0, 1}
